name: pm
description: Project-management layer for agentic development. /pm:pm-scaffold stands up a minimal starter (day-one files only — every other folder is created on first write per the stamped CLAUDE.md taxonomy) with docs/TASKS.md as the task list unless the project names another tracker; discovery riffs work into docs/intent/<slug>.md with a size call; whats-next and stepping-away open and close each working SESSION as per-session, per-person append-only logs and keep the task list current; checkpoint re-aims a session too long to close and reopen; sibling-sessions runs two or three independent items side by side; verify-before-done gates completion claims on fresh evidence; the credential-guard hook blocks staging credential-shaped files. Utility skills: okf (knowledge-bundle format) and granola-transcript (verbatim meeting transcripts into gitignored _pm/transcripts/). SDLC.md is the portable doctrine layer — no tools named.
